name: Origami Forest at Dawn
description: Folded paper trees begin transforming into living trees, caught between paper and organic reality.
prompt: A surreal forest where folded white paper trees slowly transform into real oak trees, some branches still crisp paper, morning light through leaves, mist on grass, transition from abstract to organic, soft white, green, gold palette, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: Some ideas start folded and simple. What small habit could become your forest?
